raw_text: BD Student Movement Update — Telegram Channel. URGENT UPDATE: Despite the internet shutdown, we are relaying information through satellite connections and border area WiFi. The situation in Dhaka is critical. Army vehicles have been deployed at major intersections. Confirmed reports of live fire in Uttara and Mirpur. At least 6 students confirmed dead today alone. Medical teams are overwhelmed. We need international attention. If you are receiving this, please share through any available channel. The government is trying to impose a total information blackout. We will not be silenced. Next coordination meeting at location Delta, time shared via Signal.
